blocks.text: «In a statement of a date the day is in the nominative and the month is in the genitive: Какое сегодня число? — Сегодня пятое февраля.» «To state the date of the event both the day and the month are in the genitive: Какого числа вы уезжаете? — Десятого августа.» «In a compound ordinal number only the last word is declined.»
DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 50, pp. 153–154. · Every form on this page is the OpenCorpora dictionary's own (CC BY-SA 4.0), put together by the rules quoted above.
